evidence_rule: Only exact compiler head, source tree and actual compiled/executed guest steps can upgrade a per-case backend status to PASS. A static Node manifest test or zero-step Actions run is not guest evidence.

required_contracts: channel capability remains local to its execution domain
bounded capacity 0 is rendezvous, never silently buffered
ordinary zero-capacity receive must register a rendezvous reader; polling without registration must never deadlock
positive bounded capacity enforces FIFO and backpressure
send and receive suspend cooperatively; scheduler carrier is never parked
nb operations register a Future; try operations do not register
try_send Full and Closed preserve the original moved value
close is idempotent, queued data drains before terminal EOF
closed/empty is not conflated with temporarily-unready None
cancelled pending operations remove their registrations exactly once
borrowed and callable payloads do not cross prohibited channel boundaries
unbounded is separate and MUST NOT map to arbitrary large finite capacity
